source.name: Historic insomnia prayer with weak and very-weak transmission variants
source.notice: Fuller wording recorded in al-Busiri Ithaf 6/462 with weak chain. A shorter variant is graded very weak by al-Albani (Silsila Daifa 1328). Neither is authenticated Prophetic instruction or evidence of sleep therapy. Only a brief ancient prayer phrase is included.

prayers.title: Uyku problemlerini gideren mucizevi dua
prayers.reference: al-Busiri, Ithaf al-Khiyara 6/462 (weak chain); related al-Albani 1328 (very weak)
prayers.grade: Daif (full phrase); Daif Jiddan (related short variant)
prayers.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ غَارَتِ النُّجُومُ وَهَدَأَتِ الْعُيُونُ وَأَنْتَ حَيٌّ قَيُّومٌ لَا تَأْخُذُكَ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ أَهْدِئْ لَيْلِي وَأَنِمْ عَيْنِي
